text:
sam_cs: Quick flag  CoastalMetrics renewal in ~6w. Prod volume dropped ~79% overnight (2026-06-05). Dash: https://dash.redwood.internal/coastalmetrics
metrics-bot: ALERT: coastalmetrics-prod requests down 79% (24h). Top affected routes: /embed, /similarity-search. No 5xx spike.
ivy_csm: I pinged their PM (Jenna) this morning  she said their infra team started a "hybrid-embed" experiment routing some calls to an on-prem vector service.
ryan_sales: They also mentioned a short pilot with MistralLabs on the call last week. Logged as "competitive_pilot" in SFDC.
sam_cs: Quick usage check I ran:
```
SELECT day, sum(requests) from usage.prod
WHERE account='coastalmetrics' AND day >= '2026-05-20'
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 21;
```
Drop begins 2026-06-05 and affects all API keys. No deploys on our side per infra logs.
priya_eng: Confirmed: no deploys or runtime regressions on 2026-06-05. KV cache hit steady. Latency on remaining traffic stable.
dave_se: Support ticket #8821 shows client toggled a routing flag and changed embed batch size. Attached client config and a screenshot of their routing table. Also one trace shows a schema warning for vector dims.
sam_cs: So signals = client-side routing change + active competitive pilot. I'm proposing a triage play: 1) 20-30m health sync with their ML lead (focus on why they routed), 2) short ROI + latency one-pager for their top flow, 3) offer a 4-week metered Dedicated trial credit tied to a joint tech session, 4) provide a rollback/runback runbook and an A/B test template.
ryan_sales: Sales prefers 4-week credit + a joint tech session. If they push Mistral, propose an A/B where their heavy queries run on our Dedicated nodes for the pilot window. I'll draft the commercial language.
priya_eng: I can run a 30m migration-backstop demo Tue 10am PT and prepare a 1-page runbook covering routing fallback, prefix KV caching, and batch-size guidance.
dave_se: Evidence uploaded to ticket #8821. Also flagged the vector-dim mismatch; recommend ML lead call to confirm they didn't silently drop requests.
billing-bot: NOTE: billing hold requires customer written request + finance approval. Use /billing/hold-request with affected keys.
lucy_fin: Finance will only approve holds with written customer confirmation and evidence of migration or a billing dispute. We can expedite once docs are attached.
sam_cs: Action items: Ivy  schedule health sync w/ Jenna + include procurement; Priya  prep tech deck & runbook; Dave  attach config evidence & error traces; Ryan  draft credit language; Sam  prepare ROI + internal renewal-risk note. Set renewal_risk = "elevated" for now; escalate to "high" if usage keeps dropping before the sync. :thumbsup:
ivy_csm: Invite sent to Jenna + ML lead (Marco) for Tue 10am PT. Added agenda and pre-reads (incl. short cost draft).
sam_cs: Thanks team  keep updates here. If they confirm Mistral is moving to prod we should prepare a quick exec note and consider an accelerated offer.
ryan_sales: Draft credit posted to thread (see /shared/commercial/drafts). I'll call Jenna after the meeting invite to try to understand decision criteria.
priya_eng: Uploaded deck & runbook to /shared/cs/coastalmetrics.
dave_se: Followed up in ticket with the vector-dim example and asked for a dump of failed traces.
lucy_fin: Acknowledge. Loop me if the customer asks to pause billing so I can prep the review.
sam_cs: Closing note: renewal_risk = elevated -> re-evaluate after Tue session.
